_comment: This repository's CatHarness declaration. It exists for ONE reason, and the reason is the whole point of having a declaration: folio-assistant retired `content/` as the folio-root convention in favour of `folio/` (bean hs08, 2026-09-20). qou keeps `content/` — five folios, a bun workspace, CI paths and every cross-reference in the corpus point at it — so rather than move the tree, it SAYS where the tree is. The owner's ruling: 'qou can declare a new folio at content/'. Renaming would have been a large, mechanical, risky change to satisfy a convention; declaring is four lines and is what the mechanism is for.
name: qou
description: Quantum Observable Universe — a framework for quantum physics via rigid monoidal categories

directories._dependents_comment: REQUIRED since folio-assistant #512, and it has no default on purpose — `reproduce` would ship empty directories into every downstream folio, `skip` would silently deny one its ingestion queue. `reproduce` here because a folio directory is part of the SHAPE a folio has: an instance depending on qou wants its OWN content/, empty, not qou's five papers. Same argument as `uploads/` and `library/`, and `readDeclaration`'s own error text names `folio/` among the reproduce examples. Omitting it is not a warning — `readDeclaration` THROWS, so every call through folioDir() dies, which is every pipeline entry point.
directories.description: The authored folios: quantum-observable-universe and its siblings, each a directory holding a same-named manifest. NOT `folio/` — see `_comment`.
